_comment: Describes this release to other installs. Read by the Version & Updates panel when an operator points their server at a URL serving this file. Generated from releases/<version>.md by scripts/build-release-json.js — edit the notes file, not this one.
notes: This release is mostly about how you run it, not what it stores: the database schema is unchanged, and no migration ships with it. Upgrade the code, apply the schema (which is a no-op here), and restart. Take a backup first anyway. Reinstalling the Android app is required: the app you may have been running was signed with a key this project no longer ships, and the download it pointed at has gone. Build your own and your key updates it from then on.
